natural_language_prompt: I want to really buckle down and be more productive this week. I have a major feature launch coming up and need to put in some serious coding hours. Can you help me schedule at least 30 hours of deep coding work this week, plus I want to keep up with my climbing gym sessions (at least 2x) and my side music production project (5 hours)?

constraints_to_respect: All baseline work commitments are mandatory
persona_critical_test: Should schedule coding during peak hours (14:00-22:00)
Should NOT schedule deep work early morning
Should respect night owl sleep pattern (02:00-10:00)
Music production should be late evening/night

expected_challenges: 30 hours coding + 4 hours climbing + 5 hours music = 39 hours, plus existing commitments
Need to check climbing gym late-night hours
Sleep may be compromised if not scheduled carefully
ideal_solution_characteristics: Climbing scheduled for 21:00-23:00 if gym is open
Sleep maintained at 8 hours (02:00-10:00 or similar)
